base_plain: QQQ, 4-hour EMA, session-VWAP pullback, 1R, one 1 DTE contract
why_this_cell: PR 23's closest option cell: highest holdout Sharpe among option cells with at least 300 trades. The holdout was already looked at, so this round does not use it to choose.

selection.walk_forward: Four fresh $2,500 accounts, one each for 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023. Signals may use bars before the test year. The score is the mean of the four yearly Sharpes.
selection.winner: A refinement wins only when that mean is strictly greater than the base mean and the four years together have at least 80 trades.
selection.reported_walk_forward_account: One fresh $2,500 account from 2020-01-01 through 2023-12-31, with indicators warmed up on earlier bars.
selection.full_train_uses: The 2017-02-16 through 2023-12-31 account feeds the p-value, the deflated Sharpe, and the train-Sharpe-versus-seed-17 leg of the gate.
selection.selected_rule: If two or more refinements win, the selected rule is those winners combined with AND, and that combination is one extra trial. If exactly one wins, that refinement is the selected rule and it is already one of the eight trials. If none win, the selected rule is the base. Holdout numbers are not an input to this choice.
selection.holdout_report: Every pre-registered row is scored once on 2024-01-01 through 2026-10-06 after the choice is locked. Those holdout figures are a report, not a vote.

family.combination: one extra trial only when two or more refinements win and the combination is scored
family.bh: Benjamini-Hochberg on the 72 saved training p-values plus these new p-values
family.deflated_sharpe: Bailey and Lopez de Prado on the training daily returns, with the expanded trial count
family.gate: the original 4hr gate, unchanged. The -30% drawdown line and the 0.95 deflated-Sharpe line stay put.

refinements.change: Skip the entry when the 5-minute 9 EMA and 20 EMA are within 0.05 of the 5-minute ATR(14) of each other and the 5-minute Wilder RSI(14) is between 45 and 55, both read on the signal bar. If either indicator is not finite, the bar is not called chop.
No fill before 9:45 ET, and no fill from 11:30 ET up to but not including 13:30 ET. A 9:45 fill is allowed. A 13:30 fill is allowed. The clock is the fill open, not the signal bar.

The signal bar's volume must be at least the mean of the prior 20 completed 5-minute bars, excluding itself. Those 20 bars are the regular-hours tape and may cross the previous session. Dukascopy volume is a bid-tick count, not share volume. Fewer than 20 prior bars does not qualify.
While the pullback is armed, and on the arming bar, a 15-minute close through session VWAP against the trend disarms it. Long: close below VWAP. Short: close above VWAP. Equal is not through.

The last completed 4-hour 20 EMA must have moved at least 0.15% over the prior three 4-hour bars, in the trade's direction. Long: (ema[t] - ema[t-3]) / ema[t-3] >= 0.0015. Short: that ratio <= -0.0015. The 0.15% line is a round number, not a fitted one. A missing slope does not qualify.

Skip the day when the prior VIX1D close is strictly below the 10th percentile of the 252 VIX1D closes strictly before that print. The percentile is numpy's linear percentile. Until 252 prior closes exist, the filter does not skip. VIX is not a substitute. The VIX1D cache starts 2023-04-24, so this filter cannot bind on the 2017-2023 train or on the 2020-2023 walk-forward.

One contract cannot sell two thirds at 1R. Instead, once price trades +0.5R, later bars use the fill price as the stop, and the target is 1.5R. On the bar that first trades +0.5R, the original stop still wins if both trade, and the breakeven stop is not applied until the next bar. If that same bar trades 1.5R without the original stop, the target fills. Flat stays 15:45.
At most 2 new entries a day for this book. The base cap is 5.

combination_mechanics: Start from the VWAP-hold scan when that refinement won, otherwise the base scan. Then apply every other winning event filter. Use the breakeven exit only when that refinement won, otherwise 1R. Use the 2-trade cap only when that refinement won, otherwise 5.
random: Seed 17, same count of bars as that refinement's own signals, each bar keeps the paired signal's direction, stop one cent beyond that bar, then the same exit and the same daily cap.
overlap: QQQ Aggressive is the same 15-minute 2 SD continuation, 1R, unscaled 1 DTE, 1 cent market, one contract, cap 5, fresh $2,500. Report raw signal-day overlap, filled-trade overlap, same 15-minute bucket overlap, and the Pearson correlation of daily trade P&L.
